feeds.title: Daily Record » Politics
feeds.description: Read the most recent news updates on Politics with the Daily Record. The Daily Record aims to provide the people of Scotland with a trusted news resource that presents accurate and comprehensive coverage of local, national and international news, current affairs and sport.

feeds.title: A Scottish Liberal
feeds.description: Read the blog by a A Scottish Liberal named Andrew as he states his opinions on Scottish Politics. Andrew is a member of the Liberal Democrats, who feels politics is at its best when it empowers and is at its worst when it descends into tribal adversarialism.

feeds.title: Centre on Constitutional Change
feeds.description: Read the latest news and opinions from the Centre on Constitutional Change. The Centre on Constitutional Change applies the best of social scientific scholarship to the questions raised by the UK's evolving territorial relationships. The Centre also acts as a hub for a much wider network of scholars across the UK and beyond engaged in analysis of contemporary constitutional issues.

feeds.title: Holyrood
feeds.description: News and analysis of Scottish politics and the Scottish Parliament, Holyrood MSPs, political conferences and forums. Holyrood is Scotland's fortnightly political and current affairs magazine that keeps people informed with its award-winning and thought-provoking editorial.

feeds.title: The Press and Journal » Scottish politics
feeds.description: The Press and Journal provides breaking Scottish political news, featuring insight into local politics news from Aberdeen, Aberdeenshire, Inverness, Highlands and Islands, and Scotland. To keep yourself updated with the news, business and sport near you, visit www.pressandjournal.co.uk.

feeds.title: HeraldScotland » Politics
feeds.description: The HeraldScotland brings you the most recent news on Politics. Read about Scottish politics, Scotland's future, Brexit, and more. The Herald is a Scottish broadsheet newspaper founded in 1783. The Herald is the longest running national newspaper in the world and is the eighth oldest daily paper in the world.

feeds.title: Bella Caledonia » Politics
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest news on Scottish Politics with Bella Caledonia. Read about Scotland, UK, anti-capitalism, civil liberties, policies, and much more. Bella Caledonia is an online magazine, based in Scotland, exploring ideas of independence, self determination and autonomy.

feeds.title: The Courier » Scottish politics
feeds.description: Know about the most recent news in Scottish Politics with The Courier. We are Scotland's news website. At the heart of Tayside and Fife since 1816. Visit thecourier.co.uk for news that matters to you.

feeds.title: Wings Over Scotland
feeds.description: We are the world's most-read Scottish politics website. Wings Over Scotland is a Scottish political website, which focuses particularly on the media, whether mainstream print and broadcast organisations or the online and social-network community, as well as offering its own commentary and analysis.

feeds.title: SCOT goes POP!
feeds.description: A pro-independence blog by James Kelly - voted one of Scotland's top ten political websites. Visit the blog to read about Politics, Eurovision, Sport, Gun Control and more.

feeds.title: Scottish Daily Express » Politics
feeds.description: The latest political news on the Scottish Daily Express. Featuring all the breaking news stories, opinion and analysis. The Scottish Daily Express brings you all the latest news, politics, sport and comment from across Scotland, the rest of the UK and the world.

feeds.title: The Scottish Election Study Blog
feeds.description: Here you can read the most recent blogs by the Scottish Election Study. The Scottish Election Study (SES) is a detailed independent study of politics and elections in Scotland, funded by the Economic and Research Council. The study provides world-class data and research that provide unique insights into the political attitudes and behaviour of Scottish citizens at election time.

feeds.title: The National » Politics
feeds.description: Get the latest political news from The National. The National is the only daily newspaper that supports the idea of independence for Scotland. Find out more about Scottish news, politics, opinion, culture and features you can trust from Scotland's only pro-independence newspaper.

feeds.title: The Scotsman » Politics
feeds.description: Latest politics news and opinion from expert Scotsman journalists and contributors

feeds.title: Labour Hame
feeds.description: Labour Hame is a place for open debate about progressive politics in Scotland. Get to know news, opinions and more about Scottish Labour. Labour Hame was conceived of as a place to talk aftermath of the 2011 Scottish general election by Tom Harris MP, Kezia Dugdale MSP and others who care deeply about Scottish Labour and want it to succeed.

feeds.title: STV News » Politics
feeds.description: Find out the latest news in Politics with STV News. Get the insights in political news, find out about Scotland, UK, and other international political news too. STV has been serving the people of Scotland for over 60 years. We work hard to make all of our reporting impartial, accurate and fair as well as engaging, entertaining and reflective of Scotland's diverse society and culture.

feeds.title: Lily of St. Leonards
feeds.description: Lily of St. Leonards is a blog that provides a commentary on Scottish politics by Effie Deans. After studying in Edinburgh, Cambridge, Copenhagen and Nizhny Novgorod, Effie returned home to rural Aberdeenshire, where she reads Dostoevsky in Russian and finds inspiration in the works of Walter Scott.
